slave 1 replied to "Read Coils": 16 bit states, 4 ON / 12 OFF (details below)

── Data details ──
00001 = ON
00002 = OFF
00003 = ON
00004 = OFF
00005 = OFF
00006 = OFF
00007 = OFF
00008 = OFF
00009 = OFF
00010 = ON
00011 = OFF
00012 = ON
00013 = OFF
00014 = OFF
00015 = OFF
00016 = OFF
Note: the response frame carries no start address or quantity; numbering starts at 00001 by default and the last byte may contain padding bits — refer to the matching request

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 05  Length                  5 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
01     Function code           0x01 = Read Coils
02     Byte count              2 data bytes
05 0A  Data                    each bit is the state of one coil (LSB first within each byte)

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus TCP (11 bytes total)
Transaction ID: 0x0001
Protocol ID: 0x0000
Length field: 5 (5 bytes actually follow)
Unit ID: 1
Function: 0x01 (Read Coils)
Byte count: 2
Data: 05 0A
PDU: 01 02 05 0A
